added_comments.text: Work in integer minor units so the adjustment absorbs the whole difference exactly

rationale: reconcileTotal remains the same plug-line reconciliation mechanism described as the pre-existing workaround; the agent generalized its hardcoded ±0.01 adjustment to compute the exact diff in integer minor units, which fixes the reported symptom and similar multi-cent cases but never touches whatever upstream rounding in pricing/tax calculation causes lines to disagree with the total in the first place. The minorUnits-based factor correctly preserves JPY's whole-yen, no-scaling behavior.
